model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%) for multiple models. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number”, is a logarithmic scale, ranges from 10⁰ to 10³, and has tick labels at intervals of 10⁰, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)”, is a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 65, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The black line, labeled “Base”, begins at approximately 60 at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and declines to approximately 5 at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The red line, labeled “FT”, starts at about 45 at 10⁰ and decreases to around 10 at 10³. The purple line, labeled “IKE”, starts at approximately 45 at 10⁰ and decreases to around 0 at 10³. The green line, labeled “MEND”, begins at approximately 40 at 10⁰ and increases to approximately 45 at 10³. The blue line, labeled “MEMIT”, starts at roughly 25 at 10⁰ and rises to approximately 50 at 10³. The pink line, labeled “ROME”, begins at about 50 at 10⁰ and declines to approximately 40 at 10³.
